scope: Source and archived-healthy review only; no JVM, fault trial, or checklist edit
decision: Existing unmodified MiniCluster JUnit reaches the exact check. No source-backed physical pretarget I/O fault door relevant to this bind-address predicate was found for that test; retain source-weak-candidate status rather than no-suitable-cluster-test.
source_evidence: TestInfoServers.java:51-64 enables ephemeral info ports and starts a MiniCluster; :84-94 reads master and RS info ports and HTTP pages only after startup. It does not set either bindAddress key.

HRegionServer.java:744 calls putUpWebUI in the constructor. At :2467-2482 the method reads the master or RS bindAddress from Configuration (fallback 0.0.0.0), then tests Addressing.isLocalAddress(InetAddress.getByName(addr)); the selected throw is :2487. InfoServer construction, bind, and HTTP serving begin only at :2493-2497.

hbase-default.xml:121-122 and :186-187 set both bind addresses to 0.0.0.0. Addressing.java:141-153 accepts an any-local address immediately; NetworkInterface.getByInetAddress runs only for a nonlocal, nonloopback address. The existing test sources contain no exact-key bindAddress override.

InetAddress.getByName at HRegionServer.java:2482 is the only precheck resolution call in the target expression; with the numeric default it requires no DNS lookup. An exception there exits before the selected branch. The existing RpcServer.call @447 site is unrelated to the already-read startup Configuration; later InfoServer or test HTTP I/O occurs after the check.

JVMClusterUtil.java:85 and :124 construct RegionServer and Master before their indexed thread wrappers at :93 and :137. The archived two checks have node=unknown. The case-local constructor-actor overlay addresses identity only; it supplies no predicate-relevant physical I/O door.

next_gate: A different existing unmodified cluster JUnit would need to supply a bind address affected by real pretarget I/O and show named exact-check continuation after that fault. A named actor alone does not close this source gap.
